name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();excluded={'MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt'}
rows=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not f.is_file():continue
 rel=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if rel in excluded:continue
 assert not f.is_symlink()
 b=f.read_bytes();rows.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
assert json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
manifest={'scope':'exhaustive regular files under own lane only, after frozen-after verification','files':rows,'file_count':len(rows),'completed_runner_receipts':[r['path'] for r in rows if r['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')],'terminal_noncircular_exclusions':{'MANIFEST.json':'own bytes cannot be included in own digest list','seal_manifest.receipt.json':'runner creates after this child exits; terminal seal receipt','seal_manifest.output.txt':'runner creates after this child exits; terminal seal output'},'no_later_frozen_writes':True,'credit':0,'campaign_new':57,'total':96}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
actual=json.loads((p/'MANIFEST.json').read_text())
for row in actual['files']:
 b=(p/row['path']).read_bytes();assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'sealed_files':len(rows),'completed_runner_receipts':len(manifest['completed_runner_receipts']),'frozen_count':30,'frozen_mismatches':0,'exclusions':sorted(excluded),'credit':0,'campaign':'57/60','total':96}))
